title: Config Sync run history (run-history.json)
description: The device-local log of past runs, one JSON array, newest handling per src/main.ts's retention settings (data.json's `runHistory`: maxCount/maxDays). Default location {configDir}/plugins/config-sync/run-history.json; the path is configurable and the file never syncs — it describes this device's own history. Authority: src/core/runHistory.ts's RunRecord and src/core/types.ts's GroupResult.

at.description: Milliseconds since the epoch, stamped when the record is written.

kind.description: What ran. The first five move settings; "stop-sync" and "delete-leftover" are removal actions that prune the tracked set / the store.

remote.description: The remote's name for pull/push; null for local runs.

status.description: Worst status across the run's per-item results.

issues.description: How many items ended in warning or error.

desc.description: One-line human summary, shown in the history list.

results.description: Full per-item detail for the detail view (src/core/types.ts's GroupResult); empty for removal actions.

group.description: The item/group name this result describes.

needsAppReload.description: true when the run touched files Obsidian only re-reads at app reload.

removed.description: stop-sync only: labels of the items removed from sync.

deletedFiles.description: stop-sync / delete-leftover: store paths deleted (without the "store/" prefix).
